args.query:
Below is the content of the webpage www.resume-templates.com. List ALL hyperlinks (URLs) that appear in this content, in the order they appear, together with a short description of what each link points to (for example the name of the resume template). The 'links' and 'descriptions' lists must be aligned by index and have equal length. If the content contains no hyperlinks at all, return two empty lists. Webpage content:

Resume Templates

You can find and download clean and professional resume templates for job applications.

Download Links | Contact

Respect others online. Think before you post.

I need to download a resume template file from the website www.resume-templates.com. The user's colleague Alice asked the user to download 'the resume template we will use' from this site. Content of the site's main page:

Resume Templates

You can find and download clean and professional resume templates for job applications.

Download Links | Contact

Respect others online. Think before you post.
. Hyperlinks found on the page, aligned with their descriptions: ['https://www.resume-templates.com/download_links', 'https://www.resume-templates.com/contact'] <-> ['Download Links page – where users can find and download clean and professional resume templates for job applications', 'Contact page – for getting in touch with the site']. Choose exactly ONE URL that is most likely to be the direct download link of the resume template file to use. Prefer URLs from the hyperlink list; if that list is empty, use any download URL that can be inferred from the page content; if none can be inferred, use 'www.resume-templates.com'. Set is_direct_download to true only if the chosen URL points directly to a downloadable template file (for example a .docx/.pdf/.zip file link or an explicit download link); otherwise set it to false. Do not invent URLs that do not appear in the provided information.
